directions: • Adjust rack to top position and preheat oven to 425 degrees. Wash and dry produce. • Drain and rinse chickpeas; dry thoroughly with paper towels. Trim, peel, and quarter carrot lengthwise; cut crosswise into ¼-inch-thick pieces. Zest and quarter lemon. Remove and discard any large stems from kale; finely chop leaves. Place raisins in a small bowl with enough hot water to just cover.

• Toss chickpeas on a baking sheet with a large drizzle of olive oil, half the curry powder (you’ll use more in the next step), salt, and pepper. • Roast on top rack until crispy, 18-20 minutes. (It’s natural for chickpeas to pop a bit as they roast.)

• While chickpeas roast, melt 1 TBSP butter (2 TBSP for 4 servings) in a small pot over high heat. Add carrot and ¼ tsp curry powder (½ tsp for 4). (You’ll use the rest of the curry powder in the next step.) Cook, stirring, until fragrant, 1-2 minutes. • Add rice, 1 cup water (1¾ cups for 4), stock concentrate, and a big pinch of salt. Bring to a boil, then cover and reduce to a low simmer. Cook until rice is tender, 15-18 minutes. Keep covered off heat until ready to serve.

• Meanwhile, in a medium microwave-safe bowl, combine juice from three lemon wedges and 1 tsp sugar (six wedges and 2 tsp sugar for 4 servings); stir to dissolve. Add cabbage and 2 TBSP water (4 TBSP for 4); season with salt and pepper. Microwave for 1 minute. Set aside, tossing occasionally, until ready to serve. • In a second small bowl, combine sour cream, lemon zest, remaining curry powder, and juice from remaining lemon. Season with salt and pepper. Add water 1 tsp at a time until mixture reaches a drizzling consistency.

• Heat a large drizzle of olive oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add kale and season with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until tender, 5-7 minutes. • Stir in 1 TBSP butter (2 TBSP for 4 servings) until melted. Remove from heat.

• Fluff rice with a fork; stir in 1 TBSP butter (2 TBSP for 4 servings) and season with salt and pepper. • Divide rice between bowls. Top with kale, pickled cabbage (draining first), and chickpeas in separate sections. Drain and sprinkle raisins (roughly chopping first if desired) over top. Drizzle with dressing and serve.

recipes.name: Sheet Pan Parmesan Chicken with Roasted Green Beans & Garlic Bread
recipes.ingredientsRaw:
3 tablespoon Parmesan Cheese
¼ cup Panko Breadcrumbs

10 ounce Chicken Cutlets
6 ounce Green Beans
1 unit Demi-Baguette
2 tablespoon Garlic Herb Butter

Salt
Pepper

1 teaspoon Cooking Oil
directions: • Adjust rack to middle position (middle and top for 4 servings) and preheat oven to 425 degrees. Wash and dry produce. Trim green beans if necessary. • In a small bowl, combine panko, Parmesan, Fry Seasoning, a large drizzle of olive oil, and a pinch of salt and pepper.

• Pat chicken* dry with paper towels; season all over with salt and pepper. Place on one side of a baking sheet (for 4 servings, spread out across entire sheet). • Evenly brush tops of chicken cutlets with sour cream. Mound coated sides with panko mixture, pressing to adhere. Roast on middle rack for 5 minutes (you’ll add the green beans then).

• Toss green beans on opposite side of sheet from chicken with a drizzle of oil, salt, and pepper. (For 4 servings, toss green beans on a second sheet.) • Roast on middle rack until chicken is crispy and cooked through and green beans are tender and lightly browned at the edges, 12-15 minutes. (For 4, roast chicken on middle rack and green beans on top rack.) TIP: Green beans may finish before chicken—if so, remove from oven and continue roasting chicken.

• Meanwhile, halve baguette lengthwise. When chicken has 5 minutes left, toast baguette in oven or toaster oven until lightly golden. • Spread cut sides of baguette with garlic herb butter. • Divide chicken, green beans, and garlic bread between plates. Serve. ***Chicken is fully cooked when internal temperature reaches 165°.***

• Adjust rack to top position (top and middle positions for 4 servings) and preheat oven to 450 degrees. Wash and dry produce. • Cut broccoli into bite-size pieces if necessary. Cut potatoes into ½-inch-thick wedges.

• In a small bowl, combine two packets of sour cream and a pinch of Garden Ranch Spice (four packets of sour cream and a big pinch of Garden Ranch Spice for 4 servings). (You’ll use more Garden Ranch Spice later.) • Season with salt and pepper. Add water 1 tsp at a time until mixture reaches a drizzling consistency.
• In a second small bowl, combine panko, a drizzle of oil (large drizzle for 4 servings), salt, and pepper.

• Toss broccoli on one side of a baking sheet with a drizzle of oil, 2 tsp Garden Ranch Spice (4 tsp for 4 servings), salt, and pepper. (Be sure to measure the Garden Ranch Spice—we sent more!) • Toss potatoes on empty side of sheet with a drizzle of oil, salt, and pepper. (For 4, toss broccoli and potatoes on two separate sheets.)

• Pat chicken* dry with paper towels and season all over with half the Fry Seasoning (all for 4 servings), salt, and pepper. • Push veggies to one side of sheet (for 4, push broccoli to one side of sheet). Place chicken on empty side of sheet; evenly spread tops of chicken with remaining sour cream. Mound coated sides with seasoned panko, pressing to adhere (no need to coat the undersides). • Roast on top rack until veggies are roasted and browned and chicken is cooked through, 15-20 minutes. (For 4, roast on top and middle racks, swapping rack positions halfway through.)
• Divide chicken, potatoes, and broccoli between plates. Drizzle crema over chicken. Serve. ***Chicken is fully cooked when internal temperature reaches 165°.***

Sheet Pan Chicken & Pepper Fajitas with Pico de Gallo, Monterey Jack & Lime Crema
directions: • Adjust rack to top position and preheat oven to 425 degrees. Wash and dry produce. • Halve, peel, and thinly slice onion; mince a few slices until you have 2 TBSP (4 TBSP for 4 servings). Halve, core, and thinly slice green pepper into strips.
• Toss sliced onion and green pepper on one side of a baking sheet with a drizzle of oil, salt, and pepper. • Roast on top rack for 5 minutes (you’ll add more to the sheet then).
• While veggies roast, pat chicken* dry with paper towels. Season all over with Fajita Spice, salt, and pepper. Drizzle with oil and rub to evenly coat.

• Once veggies have roasted 5 minutes, remove baking sheet from oven. Carefully add chicken to empty side. • Return to top rack until chicken is browned and cooked through and veggies are tender and slightly crisp, 15-18 minutes. TIP: If veggies are done before chicken, remove from sheet and continue roasting chicken. • Transfer chicken to a cutting board; let rest at least 5 minutes.

• Meanwhile, dice tomato. Roughly chop cilantro. Zest and quarter lime. • In a small bowl, combine tomato, cilantro, minced onion, and a squeeze of lime juice. Season with salt.

• Wrap tortillas in damp paper towels and microwave until warm and pliable, 30 seconds. • Thinly slice chicken crosswise. • Divide tortillas between plates and fill with chicken and veggies. Top with pico de gallo, Monterey Jack, and lime crema. Serve with remaining lime wedges on the side. TIP: Serve chicken, veggies, pico de gallo, Monterey Jack, lime crema, and lime wedges in separate bowls or plates for a build-your-own fajita bar!

recipes.name: Crantastic Turkey Burgers with Jammy Mayo and a Green Salad
directions: **Wash and dry all produce.** Preheat grill to high or oven or toaster oven to 400 degrees. Pick leaves from **sage**; discard stems. Mince leaves until you have 1½ tsp. Peel **shallot**, then grate into a medium bowl. ***TIP:*** Alternatively, finely mince shallot.

Add **turkey, sage, ½ tsp thyme**, and **¼ cup panko** (we sent more thyme and panko) to bowl with shallot. Season with **salt** and **pepper** (we used ½ tsp kosher salt). Mix with your hands until just combined, then form into two patties slightly wider than the buns.

Heat a drizzle of **olive oil** in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add **turkey patties** and cook until no longer pink in center, 5-6 minutes per side. ***TIP:*** If grilling, grill patties on cleaned and oiled grates over direct heat.

Meanwhile, stir together **mayonnaise** and **1 TBSP cranberry jam** (we sent more) in a small bowl. Season with **salt** and **pepper**. Split **buns** and place in oven (or toaster oven) until golden, 3-5 minutes. ***TIP:*** If grilling, toast buns on grill over indirect heat.
Toss together **mixed greens, dried cranberries, pecans, 1 TBSP balsamic vinegar** (we sent more), and a drizzle of **olive oil** in a large bowl. Season with **salt** and **pepper**.
Spread **cranberry mayo** on **buns**. Fill each with a **turkey patty** and a small handful of **salad**. Serve with remaining salad on the side.

directions: Wash and dry all produce. Adjust rack to upper position and preheat oven to 450 degrees. Set aside sour cream at room temperature. Cut potatoes into ½-inch-thick wedges. Toss potatoes on a baking sheet with a drizzle of oil. Season with salt, pepper, and 1½ tsp barbecue seasoning (we’ll use the rest in the next step). Roast in oven until tender and crisped, 20-25 minutes, flipping halfway through.

In a medium bowl, combine turkey with remaining barbecue seasoning and 1 tsp ketchup (save the rest for spreading on the buns). Season turkey mixture with salt and pepper (we used 1 tsp kosher salt). Shape into two ¾-inch-thick patties.

Transfer patties to a plate to rest once done. Wipe out pan.

Melt 2 TBSP butter in pan used for patties over medium-high heat. Add scallion whites and cook, tossing, until just softened, 1-2 minutes. Pour in 2 TBSP water and bring to a simmer. Remove pan from heat and whisk in cheddar and sour cream until smooth and well-combined. Season with salt and pepper. TIP: If queso thickens before serving, warm over low heat, stirring constantly.

Spread bun bottoms with rest of the ketchup, then place patties on each and spoon a little queso over. Top with pickle, tomato slices, and remaining bun halves. recipes.name: Green Chili White Bean Enchiladas
directions: Arrange a rack in center of oven; preheat to 350°. Grease an 11" x 7" casserole dish with cooking spray.

recipes.name: One-Pan Beef Enchiladas Verdes
recipes.ingredientsRaw:
1 lb Ground Beef
1 unit Yellow Onion
2 cloves Garlic
8 unit Corn Tortillas
1 cup Salsa Verde
1 cup Shredded Mexican Cheese Blend
1 tsp Chili Powder
1 tsp Ground Cumin
1/2 cup Sour Cream
1/4 cup Fresh Cilantro
directions: Preheat the oven to 425°F. Dice the **onion** and mince the **garlic**.
Heat a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the **ground beef** with the **onion**, **garlic**, **chili powder**, and **cumin** until browned, 5-6 minutes; season with salt and pepper.
Stir in half the **salsa verde**. Warm the **corn tortillas** until pliable, then fill each with the beef mixture, roll, and nestle seam-side down in the skillet.
Pour the remaining **salsa verde** over the top and sprinkle with **shredded cheese**. Bake 10-12 minutes, until bubbly.
Top with dollops of **sour cream** and chopped **cilantro** before serving.

recipes.ingredientsRaw:
1 lb Ground Beef
1 head Broccoli
2 cloves Garlic
1 tbsp Fresh Ginger
3 tbsp Soy Sauce
2 tbsp Brown Sugar
1 tbsp Rice Vinegar
1 tsp Sesame Oil
2 cups Jasmine Rice
1 tbsp Sesame Seeds
recipes.name: Sweet Soy Glazed Beef & Broccoli
directions: Cook the **jasmine rice** according to package directions.
Cut the **broccoli** into small florets. Mince the **garlic** and **ginger**.
In a small bowl, whisk together the **soy sauce**, **brown sugar**, and **rice vinegar**.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and brown the **ground beef**, breaking it up, 4-5 minutes. Add the **garlic** and **ginger** and cook 1 minute.
Add the **broccoli** and the soy-sugar sauce; cook, stirring, until the broccoli is crisp-tender and the sauce has thickened, 4-5 minutes. Finish with **sesame oil**.
Serve over the **rice**, sprinkled with **sesame seeds**.

recipes.ingredientsRaw:
1 lb Ground Beef
1 can Black Beans
1 packet Taco Seasoning
8 unit Small Flour Tortillas
1 cup Shredded Cheddar Cheese
1 unit Roma Tomato
1/4 head Iceberg Lettuce
1/2 cup Sour Cream
1 unit Lime
directions: Drain and rinse the **black beans**. Dice the **tomato** and shred the **lettuce**.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and brown the **ground beef**, 4-5 minutes. Drain any excess fat.
Stir in the **taco seasoning**, **black beans**, and 1/4 cup water; simmer 3-4 minutes until slightly thickened.
Warm the **tortillas**. Fill with the beef mixture and top with **cheddar cheese**, **tomato**, and **lettuce**.
Serve with **sour cream** and a squeeze of **lime**.
recipes.name: Cheesy Beef & Black Bean Tacos

recipes.ingredientsRaw:
1 lb Ground Beef
8 oz Medium Pasta Shells
1 unit Yellow Onion
2 cloves Garlic
1 can Diced Tomatoes
1 cup Beef Stock
1 cup Shredded Cheddar Cheese
1 tsp Smoked Paprika
2 tbsp Tomato Paste
directions: Dice the **onion** and mince the **garlic**.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and brown the **ground beef** with the **onion**, 4-5 minutes. Add the **garlic** and **smoked paprika**; cook 1 minute.
Stir in the **tomato paste**, **diced tomatoes**, **beef stock**, and dry **pasta shells**. Bring to a boil, then cover and simmer 12-15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the pasta is tender.
Remove from heat and stir in the **cheddar cheese** until melted. Season with salt and pepper.
recipes.name: Skillet Beef & Cheddar Shells
Beef Bulgogi Rice Bowls
recipes.ingredientsRaw:
1 lb Ground Beef
3 tbsp Soy Sauce
2 tbsp Brown Sugar
1 tbsp Sesame Oil
2 cloves Garlic
1 tbsp Fresh Ginger
1 unit Carrot
3 unit Scallions
2 cups Jasmine Rice
1 tbsp Sesame Seeds
directions: Cook the **jasmine rice** according to package directions.
Mince the **garlic** and **ginger**. Julienne the **carrot** and thinly slice the **scallions**.
Whisk the **soy sauce**, **brown sugar**, and **sesame oil** together in a small bowl.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and brown the **ground beef** with the **garlic** and **ginger**, 4-5 minutes.
Add the sauce and **carrot**; cook 2-3 minutes until the sauce coats the beef and slightly thickens.
Serve over the **rice**, topped with **scallions** and **sesame seeds**.
Dice the **onion** and **bell pepper**.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and brown the **ground beef** with the **onion** and **bell pepper**, 5-6 minutes.
Stir in the **tomato sauce**, **ketchup**, **Worcestershire sauce**, and **brown sugar**. Simmer 8-10 minutes, until thickened.
Toast the **hamburger buns** and pile the beef mixture on top.
recipes.name: Classic Beef Sloppy Joes
recipes.ingredientsRaw:
1 lb Ground Beef
1 unit Yellow Onion
1 unit Green Bell Pepper
1 can Tomato Sauce
2 tbsp Ketchup
1 tbsp Worcestershire Sauce
1 tbsp Brown Sugar
4 unit Hamburger Buns

directions: Preheat the oven to 375°F. Slice the tops off the **bell peppers** and remove the seeds.
Dice the **onion** and mince the **garlic**.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat and brown the **ground beef** with the **onion** and **garlic**, 5-6 minutes. Stir in the **diced tomatoes**, **cooked rice**, and **Italian seasoning**.
Stuff the mixture into the **bell peppers** and place upright in a baking dish. Cover with foil and bake 25 minutes.
Uncover, top with **mozzarella cheese**, and bake 5 more minutes until melted.
recipes.ingredientsRaw:
1 lb Ground Beef
4 unit Bell Peppers
1 cup Cooked Rice
1 can Diced Tomatoes
1 unit Yellow Onion
2 cloves Garlic
1 cup Shredded Mozzarella Cheese

recipes.name: Stuffed Bell Peppers with Beef & Rice

recipes.ingredientsRaw:
1 lb Ground Beef
12 oz Spaghetti
1 unit Yellow Onion
3 cloves Garlic
1 can Crushed Tomatoes
2 tbsp Tomato Paste
1 tsp Italian Seasoning
1/4 cup Grated Parmesan Cheese
2 tbsp Fresh Basil
directions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the **spaghetti** until al dente; reserve 1/2 cup pasta water before draining.
Dice the **onion** and mince the **garlic**.
Heat a large pot over medium-high heat and brown the **ground beef** with the **onion** and **garlic**, 5-6 minutes.
Stir in the **tomato paste**, **crushed tomatoes**, and **Italian seasoning**. Simmer 10 minutes, thinning with reserved pasta water as needed.
Toss the sauce with the **spaghetti**. Top with **Parmesan cheese** and torn **basil**.
recipes.name: Weeknight Spaghetti with Beef Meat Sauce

directions: Cook the **jasmine rice** according to package directions.
Mince the **garlic**. Whisk together the **honey**, **soy sauce**, **rice vinegar**, and **cornstarch**.
Season the **chicken thighs** with salt and pepper. Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and sear until golden and cooked through, 5-6 minutes per side; remove from the skillet.
Add the **garlic** to the skillet and cook 30 seconds, then add the honey-soy mixture and simmer until thickened, 1-2 minutes.
Return the chicken to the skillet and coat in the glaze. Serve over **rice**, topped with sliced **scallions**.
recipes.name: Honey Garlic Chicken Thighs with Rice
recipes.ingredientsRaw:
1.5 lb Boneless Chicken Thighs
3 tbsp Honey
3 tbsp Soy Sauce
3 cloves Garlic
1 tbsp Rice Vinegar
1 tsp Cornstarch
2 cups Jasmine Rice
2 unit Scallions

recipes.name: Sheet Pan Chicken Fajitas
recipes.ingredientsRaw:
1.5 lb Chicken Breast
1 unit Red Bell Pepper
1 unit Green Bell Pepper
1 unit Yellow Onion
2 tbsp Olive Oil
1 packet Fajita Seasoning
8 unit Flour Tortillas
1/2 cup Sour Cream
1 unit Lime
directions: Preheat the oven to 425°F. Slice the **chicken breast**, **bell peppers**, and **onion** into strips.
Toss everything on a sheet pan with the **olive oil** and **fajita seasoning**.
Roast 20-22 minutes, stirring halfway, until the chicken is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
Warm the **tortillas** and serve the chicken and vegetables with **sour cream** and a squeeze of **lime**.

recipes.ingredientsRaw:
4 unit Chicken Breast Cutlets
1 cup Panko Breadcrumbs
1/2 cup Grated Parmesan Cheese
1 unit Egg
1 cup Marinara Sauce
1 cup Shredded Mozzarella Cheese
8 oz Spaghetti
1 tsp Italian Seasoning
directions: Preheat the oven to 425°F and set a wire rack over a baking sheet lined with foil.
Bring a pot of salted water to a boil and cook the **spaghetti** until al dente; drain.
Mix the **panko** with the **Parmesan cheese** and **Italian seasoning**. Beat the **egg** in a shallow bowl.
Dip each **chicken cutlet** in **egg**, then coat in the panko mixture. Place on the rack and bake 18-20 minutes, until golden and cooked through.
Top each cutlet with **marinara sauce** and **mozzarella cheese**; return to the oven for 3-4 minutes until melted. Serve over the **spaghetti**.
recipes.name: Crispy Baked Chicken Parmesan

directions: Cook the **basmati rice** according to package directions.
Cut the **chicken thighs** into bite-sized pieces. Dice the **onion**; mince the **garlic** and **ginger**.
Heat a large pot over medium-high heat and sear the **chicken** until browned, 4-5 minutes; remove.
Add the **onion** to the pot and cook until soft, 3-4 minutes. Add the **garlic**, **ginger**, and **tikka masala spice blend**; cook 1 minute.
Stir in the **crushed tomatoes** and return the chicken to the pot. Simmer 10 minutes, then stir in the **heavy cream**.
Serve over the **rice**, topped with **cilantro**.
recipes.name: Chicken Tikka Masala with Basmati Rice
recipes.ingredientsRaw:
1.5 lb Chicken Thighs
1 unit Yellow Onion
3 cloves Garlic
1 tbsp Fresh Ginger
2 tbsp Tikka Masala Spice Blend

recipes.name: Teriyaki Chicken & Veggie Stir-Fry
directions: Cook the **jasmine rice** according to package directions.
Cut the **chicken breast** into bite-sized pieces. Cut the **broccoli** into florets and slice the **carrot** and **bell pepper**.
Whisk together the **soy sauce**, **honey**, **rice vinegar**, and **cornstarch**.
Heat a large skillet or wok over high heat and cook the **chicken** until browned and cooked through, 5-6 minutes; remove.
Add the vegetables to the skillet and stir-fry 4-5 minutes until crisp-tender. Return the chicken, add the sauce, and toss until glossy, 1-2 minutes.
Serve over the **rice**.

recipes.ingredientsRaw:
4 unit Bone-In Pork Chops
1.5 lb Yukon Gold Potatoes
4 tbsp Butter
3 cloves Garlic
1/4 cup Milk
1 tbsp Fresh Thyme
2 tbsp Olive Oil
recipes.name: Garlic Butter Pork Chops with Mashed Potatoes
directions: Peel and quarter the **potatoes**; boil in salted water until fork-tender, 15-18 minutes.
Meanwhile, season the **pork chops** with salt and pepper. Heat the **olive oil** in a large skillet over medium-high heat and sear the chops 4-5 minutes per side, until cooked through; remove.
Mince the **garlic**. Add 2 tbsp **butter** and the **garlic** to the skillet; cook 30 seconds, then spoon over the chops along with the **thyme**.
Drain the potatoes and mash with the remaining **butter** and **milk**. Season with salt and pepper.
Serve the pork chops over the mashed potatoes.
Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the **penne pasta** until al dente; drain.
Slice the **sausage** into rounds and slice the **bell peppers** and **onion**.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and brown the **sausage**, 3-4 minutes; remove.
Add the **bell peppers** and **onion** to the skillet with the **Cajun seasoning** and cook until softened, 4-5 minutes.
Return the sausage to the skillet, stir in the **heavy cream**, and simmer 2-3 minutes. Toss with the **pasta** and top with **Parmesan cheese**.
recipes.name: Cajun Sausage & Pepper Pasta
recipes.ingredientsRaw:
12 oz Smoked Sausage
12 oz Penne Pasta
1 unit Red Bell Pepper
1 unit Green Bell Pepper
1 unit Yellow Onion
1 tbsp Cajun Seasoning
1 cup Heavy Cream
1/4 cup Grated Parmesan Cheese

directions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the **linguine** until al dente; reserve 1/2 cup pasta water before draining.
Peel and devein the **shrimp**, if needed. Mince the **garlic** and zest and juice the **lemon**.
Heat 2 tbsp **butter** in a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook the **shrimp** until pink, 2-3 minutes per side; remove.

Add the **garlic** and **red pepper flakes** to the skillet and cook 30 seconds. Add the **white wine** and simmer 2 minutes, then stir in the remaining **butter**, **lemon juice**, and **lemon zest**.
Return the shrimp to the skillet along with the **linguine**, tossing with a splash of pasta water. Finish with **parsley**.
recipes.name: Lemon Garlic Shrimp Scampi
recipes.ingredientsRaw:
1 lb Shrimp
12 oz Linguine
4 tbsp Butter
4 cloves Garlic
1/2 cup White Wine
1 unit Lemon
2 tbsp Fresh Parsley
1/4 tsp Red Pepper Flakes

4 unit Salmon Fillets
1 head Broccoli
3 tbsp Honey
3 tbsp Soy Sauce
2 cloves Garlic
1 tbsp Olive Oil
2 cups Jasmine Rice
1 tsp Sesame Seeds
directions: Cook the **jasmine rice** according to package directions.
Preheat the oven to 400°F. Cut the **broccoli** into florets and toss with the **olive oil** on a sheet pan; roast 12-15 minutes.
Mince the **garlic** and whisk with the **honey** and **soy sauce**.
Season the **salmon fillets** with salt and pepper. Heat a skillet over medium-high heat and sear the salmon 3-4 minutes per side.
Add the honey-soy mixture to the skillet and simmer, spooning over the salmon, until glazed and the salmon is cooked through, 1-2 minutes.
Serve the salmon and broccoli over the **rice**, sprinkled with **sesame seeds**.
recipes.name: Honey Garlic Glazed Salmon with Broccoli

recipes.ingredientsRaw:
1 can Black Beans
1 cup Corn Kernels
8 unit Large Flour Tortillas
2 cups Shredded Mexican Cheese Blend
1 tsp Ground Cumin
1 tsp Chili Powder
1/2 cup Sour Cream
1/4 cup Fresh Cilantro
directions: Drain and rinse the **black beans**. In a bowl, combine the **black beans**, **corn**, **cumin**, and **chili powder**.
Lay out the **tortillas** and sprinkle half of each with **cheese**, then the bean mixture, then more **cheese**. Fold in half.
Heat a large skillet over medium heat and cook each quesadilla 2-3 minutes per side, until golden and the cheese has melted.
Slice into wedges and serve with **sour cream** and chopped **cilantro**.
recipes.name: Black Bean & Corn Quesadillas

directions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the **penne pasta** until al dente; reserve 1/2 cup pasta water before draining.
Halve the **cherry tomatoes** and cube the **mozzarella**. Mince the **garlic**.
Heat the **olive oil** in a large skillet over medium heat and cook the **garlic** 30 seconds. Add the **cherry tomatoes** and cook until just softened, 3-4 minutes.
Toss in the **pasta**, a splash of pasta water, and the **mozzarella**; toss until the cheese just begins to melt.
Top with torn **basil**, a drizzle of **balsamic glaze**, and **Parmesan cheese**.
recipes.name: Caprese Pasta with Cherry Tomatoes & Mozzarella
recipes.ingredientsRaw:
12 oz Penne Pasta
2 cups Cherry Tomatoes
8 oz Fresh Mozzarella
3 tbsp Olive Oil
3 cloves Garlic
1/4 cup Fresh Basil
2 tbsp Balsamic Glaze
1/4 cup Grated Parmesan Cheese

3 cups Cooked Rice
3 unit Eggs
1 cup Frozen Peas & Carrots
3 unit Scallions
2 cloves Garlic
3 tbsp Soy Sauce
1 tbsp Sesame Oil
2 tbsp Vegetable Oil
recipes.name: Veggie Fried Rice with Scrambled Egg
directions: Slice the **scallions** and mince the **garlic**. Beat the **eggs** in a small bowl.
Heat 1 tbsp **vegetable oil** in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Scramble the **eggs** until just set; remove.
Add the remaining **vegetable oil** to the skillet with the **garlic** and **peas & carrots**; cook 2-3 minutes.
Add the **rice**, breaking up clumps, and stir-fry 3-4 minutes until heated through.
Stir in the **soy sauce**, **sesame oil**, scrambled egg, and most of the **scallions**. Top with the remaining scallions.

recipes.ingredientsRaw:
1 cup Jasmine Rice
1 can Coconut Milk

recipes.name: Peach Salsa Halloumi Bowls
directions: Make the coconut rice: combine the **Jasmine Rice** and **Coconut Milk** in a pot and bring to a boil. Cover, reduce the heat, and simmer 15 minutes, until the liquid is absorbed.

Remove from heat and let sit, covered, for 10 minutes, then fluff with a fork. Stir in the **Salt**, the juice and zest of 1 **Lime**, and 1/2 cup **Fresh Cilantro**; season to taste and top with **Chopped Cashews**.

Make the peach salsa: in a medium bowl, mix the **Peach**, **Red Bell Pepper**, **Red Onion**, **Fresh Cilantro**, the juice and zest of 1 **Lime**, 1 clove **Garlic**, and **Jalapeño Pepper** with **Salt**. Season to taste and chill until ready to use.

Make the cilantro lime dressing: in a food processor, combine 2 cups **Fresh Cilantro**, 1 clove **Garlic**, **Fresh Lime Juice**, **Maple Syrup**, **Ground Coriander**, and **Salt**; pulse to combine.
With the blade running, stream in the **Olive Oil** and process until smooth.
Grill the halloumi: preheat a grill or grill pan to high heat. Slice the **Halloumi Cheese** into 1/2-inch-thick planks, rub both sides with **Olive Oil**, and place on the hot grill.
Reduce the heat to medium and grill 2-3 minutes per side, until well-charred.
Assemble the bowls with the coconut rice, **Black Beans**, grilled halloumi, and sliced **Avocado**. Top with scoops of peach salsa and a drizzle of cilantro lime dressing.
Garnish with more herbs, season to taste, and serve with lime wedges.

Make the quick pickles: in a jar, combine the **Daikon Radish**, **Carrot**, **Cucumber**, and **Jalapeño Pepper** with the **Rice Vinegar**, **Water**, a pinch of **Cane Sugar**, and a pinch of **Salt**.
Make sure the liquid covers the vegetables, adding more water and vinegar if needed. Chill for at least 1 hour, or up to a week.
Make the spicy mayo: in a small bowl, stir together the **Mayonnaise**, **Sriracha**, **Fresh Lime Juice**, and **Toasted Sesame Oil**. Taste and adjust as desired.
Drain the **Tofu** and slice into 1/2-inch slices; pat dry with a towel.
Make the marinade: whisk together the **Olive Oil**, **Tamari**, the juice and zest of the **Lime**, **Garlic**, and **Ginger**.
Place the tofu in a shallow dish, pour the marinade over top, and flip to coat. Marinate at least 15 minutes.

Heat a nonstick skillet over medium-high heat with a little **Olive Oil**. Cook the tofu in a single layer, without moving it too much, until deeply golden and caramelized, a few minutes per side. Season to taste.
Split the **Mini Baguette** pieces and assemble the sandwiches with the spicy mayo, tofu, pickled vegetables, and **Fresh Cilantro**.

directions: Make the dressing: In a small bowl, whisk together the vinegar, tamari, sesame oil, ginger, garlic, and maple syrup. Set aside.

Bring an unsalted pot of water to a boil and cook the soba noodles according to the package directions. Drain and rinse well in cold water. This helps to remove starches that cause clumping. Toss the noodles with the dressing and divide into 2 to 4 bowls. Squeeze fresh lemon juice onto the avocado slices and add to the bowls along with the snap peas, edamame, radish, mint, and a sprinkle of sesame seeds. Drizzle with more tamari or sesame oil, if desired.

recipes.name: Instant Pot White Chicken Chili Recipe
directions: Place all of your ingredients into your instant pot bowl in the following order: 2 chicken breasts, drained black and white beans, chopped onion, corn with juice, tomatoes with juice, and 1/2 cup chicken broth.
Add 1/2 to 1 tsp chili powder (use 1/2 tsp to make it kid friendly), 1 tsp cumin, ranch packet. Stir everything to combine, getting some of the juice under the chicken to keep it from scorching.

Cut cream cheese into 6 pieces and place over the top of chili. Cover and seal with lid, switch the valve to the "sealing" position and cook for 20 min on manual high pressure. Once it is done cooking, let it naturally depressurize for 10 min then switch the valve to the "venting" position to completely release steam before opening lid.**

Remove the chicken breasts to a plate and shred apart with 2 forks. Stir everything together in the pot to melt the cream cheese into the chili then return the shredded chicken and stir to combine. Serve garnished with avocado and cilantro if desired.
